headline: Undergraduate at Wuhan University · Incoming Master's Student at Tsinghua SIGS (September 2027)
about: I am an undergraduate in Electronic Information Engineering at Wuhan University. I will join Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School in September 2027 for a two-year master's program in Large Model Science and Engineering.

My research interests span computer vision, multimodal large models, and ocean and atmospheric remote sensing. I am currently supervised by Dr. Yuting Zhu in Prof. Haohuan Fu's HPGC group at Tsinghua University. Previously, I was supervised by Dr. Chao Pang in Prof. Gui-Song Xia's CAPTAIN group at Wuhan University.
